Kefe coast loss: 1772 (Annexation page) against 1774 (Eyalet of Kefe page)
Start 1450 is Cliopatria's; pages say established 1480 or about 1500; the move into the Great Horde's lands (c. 1509) has no outline; Saray-Juk dates 1520, c. 1522, 1577 disagree

problems: Cross-dossier requests: ottoman-empire (me-10) should carry vassal_start 1475 and vassal_end 1774 with counterpart crimean-khanate, plus the 1772 loss of the Kefe coast; russian-empire should carry the 1774 gain of Kerch and Yenikale, the occupations of 1771-1772 and 1776-1783 and the 1783 gain; tsardom-of-russia and grand-principality-of-moscow (eu-16) should carry a vassal tint with counterpart qasim-khanate for 1452-1681; tsardom-of-russia should carry the 1588 gain of the Middle Volga steppe from nogai-horde; kazakh-khanate the 1521 and 1572 gains and kalmyk-khanate the 1636 gain, all with counterpart nogai-horde.

The golden-horde dossier dates the Crimean founding 1449; the Haci I Giray page gives March 1441 (Genoese sources) with 1449 as the traditional date. crimean-khanate uses 1441 (confidence 2) and the 1449 capital move to Qirq Yer.
Small Horde (Cliopatria, Q631210) is merged into nogai-horde (one state, Cliopatria shapes 1450-1737); the ia-03-c brief also lists small-horde, and a separate dossier there would duplicate this one.
eastern-moghulistan should start in 1514: Said Khan's Yarkent Khanate removes the Tarim from the moghulistan shape in 1514 and no Cliopatria row owns it until Eastern Moghulistan begins in 1519.

Moghulistan, East Turkestan and Eastern Chagatai Khanate rows tile exactly (1463-1474, 1475-1491, 1492-1511, 1512-1518); kept as separate dossiers, East Turkestan ended at 1469 when Yunus Khan reunited the khanate. East Turkestan Republic (same Wikidata id family) is a different state and not merged.
Qasim Khanate's Cliopatria row ends 1551 but the page has the khanate to 1681; a new keyframe 1552-1681 repeats the 1547 shape, which lies inside Cliopatria's Tsardom of Russia shape.

Page budget: crimean-khanate opened 10 pages (budget 9, one over, for the Haci I Giray page that settles the founding); some keyframe verdicts in crimean-khanate, nogai-horde, qasim-khanate and moghulistan carry '(unverified: page budget)' in their notes.
No infobox on any of the pages gives an area, so no area ratio could be computed for any keyframe.
Two guessed page titles failed (Shah_Ali_of_Kazan, Shah_Ali_Khan); Shahghali was used instead. No temporary files were left on the mount.
